name: Hermes DKG Memory Bridge
description: Hermes crypto agent action audit trail + decision recall on DKG V10 memory. Records on-chain actions (swap, bridge, mint, deploy) as provenance-tagged Knowledge Assets in DKG Working/Shared Memory, forming an immutable, queryable audit trail. Enables decision recall via SPARQL queries.

install.usageHint: Run 'hermes-dkg status' to check DKG node status, 'hermes-dkg audit <action-json>' to record a Hermes action to DKG WM.

security.notes: Hermes security model preserved: no auto-sign, no auto-publish, Spend Governor respected. SWM promotion is explicit via 'promote' subcommand. All secrets redacted before leaving the process. No vm/publish in Round 1 scope.

promotionPath: Actions recorded to Working Memory can be promoted to Shared Working Memory via explicit 'promote' command. Repeated references to the same token/action type auto-promote to SWM (sealed). VM publish stays explicit-gated (not in Round 1 scope).
fitNotes: Hermes-specific action audit trail, distinct from OpenClaw curator (PR #26) and DKG Memory MCP Server (PR #27). Plugs into Hermes's action dispatch so crypto operations are memory-backed by default, with governance-aware write path that respects Hermes's Spend Governor boundaries.
